evidence_quotes.agenda: Before I go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any question, any clarification regarding the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No, no, no problem. -- full credit applies per the no-concern-raised rule
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: keep in mind that this is just an estimate and we only factored in a little extra time in the quote based on the details that we have discussed... if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated... of course you pay less

top_strength: Proactively caught that loading the storage unit first (rather than the house) would trigger an extra transportation fee and suggested reordering the stops to save the customer money before even quoting a price -- genuine, unprompted advocacy for the customer on a complex three-stop move.
coaching_note: Made a clean explicit ask at the close but the customer said she's still calling around, and no Save Your Ass reassurance (rate commitment, self-prep tip, 'does that feel fair') was used to try to hold the sale before letting her go.
grading_note: two_layers_deep scored 15 via the no-concern-raised rule. Call did not book (customer is still comparison shopping) but Stage 1/2 execution was strong enough to clear the 80-point bar.
